title: Steps/Heartrate from watch not updating on phone
body: The steps and heartrate data on my Ticwatch Pro shows up (mostly) accurately on the xDrip watchface, but does not update in the xDrip app on my phone. The exception is if I am using the "Force Wear Collection Service" option, in which case it works normally. When this option is not enabled, the steps and heartrate in the phone app continue to display the values from whenever the Wear Collector was last used, even days later.
